description: Proposes adding a daycare center at 335 Avenue G South.
Reduces required on-site parking from 19 to 14 spaces.
Clarifies landscaping requirements for the Riversdale site.

chips.text: Councillor Timon questioned reduced parking and daycare safety at 335 Avenue G South.
Riversdale neighborhood residents are affected by the proposed zoning changes.
Administration could not provide a safety plan for the proposed daycare operation.
Public expressed concern about on-street parking and support for the amendment.

description: Brighton land rezoning from FUD to R1B and R2 districts.
Allows one to four unit dwellings on smaller lots.

chips.text: Dream Development applied for the rezoning.

description: Proposes rezoning Brighton land near Cockcroft Court.
Changes zoning from FUD to R1B and R2 districts.
Allows ongoing subdivision and development in Brighton.

chips.text: Dream Development is the applicant for the rezoning.
